showcase.title: The star factory
showcase.story: This galaxy turns about 49 suns' worth of gas into new stars every year, one of the fastest star makers in our sample.

showcase.title: The fastest shutdown
showcase.story: In less than a billion years this galaxy goes from about 39 new suns per year to almost none.

showcase.title: The jellyfish
showcase.story: It has already dived through the heart of a big group of galaxies; now it flies back out, trailing a tail of gas swept off it by the group's hot gas.
